createstellaris.ponder.coalgeneratorpond: Insert Coal to start generating power.
When Coal is in the machine place Cables on the back and they will transfer power to machines
createstellaris.ponder.dieselgeneratorpo: When a diesel bucket is in the machine place Cables on the back and they will transfer power to machines.
Insert a diesel bucket to start generating power.
createstellaris.ponder.radioactivegenera: Insert a Uranium ingot or block to start generating power.
The Radioactive Generator can generate maximum 500Fe/Tick.
When a Uranium ingot or block is in the machine place Cables on the back and they will transfer power to machines.
createstellaris.ponder.waterpumpponder.t: Place the water pump above a infinite water source.
Then give it a power source.
The water pump should start pumping water.
Attach any tier pipe to the Water pump and it will pump it into the pipe and into a attached machine.
When the Solar Panel is placed in day time it will start generating power.
The Solar Panel can generate maximum 1Fe/Tick.
When the Solar Panel is generating power place Cables on the back and they will transfer power to machines.
Generating Power with a Solar Panel
createstellaris.ponder.oxygendisponder.t: The Oxygen Distributor when placed in a closed area it can provide oxygen.
It can only make the oxygen if it has power and oxygen in the machine.
NOTE this block doesnt always work this ponder is just to show how it works not if it works.
createstellaris.ponder.cableponder.text_: A cable can transport power to attached machines.
createstellaris.ponder.pumpjackponder.te: The Pumpjack needs to be placed on a block that has oil.
you can find oil using the oil finder.
The Pumpjack needs a power source to work.
createstellaris.ponder.pipeponder.text_1: Place down any tier off pipe next to a water pump.
createstellaris.ponder.pipeponder.text_2: Make sure the pipe is connected to a machine that can take water.
createstellaris.ponder.fluidtankponder.t: Place down any tier of fluid tank.
The fluid tank canstore fluids inside.
Now give it fluids and it will store it.
createstellaris.ponder.powerbankponderst: Store energy in the power bank.
Give the power bank energy to store energy in the power bank.
createstellaris.ponder.powerbankponderus: How to take power out the power bank.
When the power bank has energy you can put stuff inside it.
Now it will start giving the item inside power.
